question: A man driving a car at a speed of 54 km/hr crosses a bridge in 1.7 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert time directly to hours: 1.7 minutes = 1.7 ÷ 60 hours

Distance = Speed × Time

Length of the bridge = 54 × (1.7 ÷ 60)

Length = 0.9 × 1.7 = 1.53 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1.53 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the car = 54 km/hr

Time taken to cross the bridge = 1.7 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 

 Speed = 54 km/hr
 Time = 1.7 minutes
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Bridge Length = ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, let us convert the speed of the car into meters per second (m/s).

⇒ Speed in m/s = 54 × (5 ÷ 18)

⇒ Speed = 3 × 5 = 15 m/s

⇒ Next, convert the given time from minutes into seconds.

⇒ Time in seconds = 1.7 × 60

⇒ Time = 102 seconds

⇒ We know that Length of the bridge = Distance covered by the car

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 15 × 102

⇒ Distance = 1530 meters

⇒ Finally, convert the distance back into kilometers (since options are in km).

⇒ Distance in km = 1530 ÷ 1000 = 1.53 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1.53 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To quickly convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the given value by 5/18. Conversely, to convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂|. When moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If two equal distances are covered at different speeds x and y, the Average Speed is given by (2xy) ÷ (x + y).
